rationale: The original thesis remains fully intact as CSX continues to consolidate tightly in the top decile of its daily range (91.5%) on strong relative volume (4.51x) despite broad market weakness (SPY -1.23%). With nearly 200 minutes remaining in the session and positive catalyst momentum supporting the bid, holding for a breakout past the $51.80 session high offers the best risk-reward.
